prompt: Why do production runbooks tell applications to iterate the keyspace with SCAN instead of KEYS?
explanation: KEYS matches the whole keyspace in one O(N) step on the main thread and blocks every other client until it finishes. SCAN walks the keyspace incrementally through a cursor in small batches, so each call is bounded and other commands interleave between calls.

options.text: SCAN iterates incrementally with a cursor and keeps the server responsive, while KEYS blocks the server in one O(N) pass
SCAN is faster because it skips expired keys during iteration
SCAN returns keys sorted lexicographically, giving deterministic results
SCAN takes no arguments and returns the entire keyspace at once
